title: Apple is holding its iPhone launch event on September 9 | TechCrunch
summary: The event is expected to be a notable one, as Apple is rumored to unveil its long-awaited foldable iPhone. The tech giant is also expected to introduce the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra, alongside new smart home devices.
